name: Mafia Life Simulator
detailed_description:
Add to Wishlist


About the Game

Crime Empire


  • Marijuana Plantations: By producing and distributing marijuana, you can achieve significant profits. Expand your plantations to improve product quality and production capacity.
  • Money Laundering: You will need to use various mechanisms to launder the illegal money you earn. Establish fake businesses and money laundering centers to legalize your funds.
  • Organ Trafficking: In the darkest corners of the criminal world, you can earn huge profits from organ trafficking. This dangerous business carries high risks, but it can also offer great rewards.
  • Arms Trafficking: Enter the arms trade to meet the weapon needs of your crime empire and generate income by selling weapons to other gangs. Establish weapon factories to produce and sell on the black market.
  • Drug Network: Organize the production and distribution of various types of drugs to build a vast drug network. This network can bring in large amounts of money, but it also comes with great dangers.

    And much more: There are many lucrative businesses waiting for you in the world of crime.

Strategic Wars


  • Controlling Illegal Businesses: Wars are fought not only to gain territory but also to control illegal businesses. Take over drug networks, organ trafficking, and other dark businesses controlled by rival gangs to strengthen your crime empire.
  • Fighting Other Gangs: Battles with rival gangs can shift the balance of power. Defeat your rivals with strategic moves and take over their territories. These battles involve not only armed conflicts but also cleverly planned traps and secret operations.
  • Territory Conquest: Expand your crime empire by conquering different territories. Each territory offers unique resources and opportunities. Establish marijuana plantations, weapon factories, and money laundering centers in the territories you conquer to increase your income.

Open World Exploration


In Mafia Life Simulator, explore a vast and detailed open world. Find hidden locations, valuable resources, and strategic points in this world full of dangers and opportunities at every corner. Fight rival gangs, discover new business opportunities, and expand your crime empire. Open world exploration will always lead you to new adventures and challenges.

Realistic Atmosphere


Mafia Life Simulator invites you to a realistic and immersive mafia world. With detailed graphics, impressive sound design, and dynamic environmental elements, you will find yourself in the heart of your crime empire. At every street corner, under every streetlight, and in every shadow, dangers and opportunities await you. The realistic atmosphere deepens your gaming experience and completely draws you in.

short_description: Build your own empire in the world of the mafia! In Mafia Life Simulator, take control of everything from marijuana farms to weapon factories, money laundering centers to drug networks. Become the undisputed leader of the region with your gang and make your name known in the world of crime.

content_descriptors.notes:
Our game, Mafia Life Simulator, contains a certain degree of mature content. This includes violence and criminal activities. Here is what you need to know about the mature content in our game:

Violence: The game includes gunfights, fight scenes, and other violent actions. Players may encounter scenes where characters engage in conflicts and fight against enemies.

Criminal Activities: Players manage various criminal activities such as marijuana plantations, money laundering, organ trafficking, and arms dealing. These elements reflect the dark and dangerous aspects of the criminal underworld.

No Alcohol and Tobacco Use: The game does not include scenes where characters consume alcohol or tobacco.

There is no sexual content in our game.

These elements are included to support the realistic and immersive atmosphere of the game. We recommend our players consider this information while playing, as they may find such scenes disturbing.
